title: Field Ops Micro-Battleflow Playdeck (sketch)
content:
Slide 1 - Title: Field Ops Micro-Battleflow (8 slides) - Sketch
Speaker note: Super compact playdeck for seller + ops to run a micro-battle with a prospect in a 30-60 minute window. Purpose: reduce friction, prove reliability, and capture SLA/econ signals.

Slide 2 - Why a micro-battle?
- Timeboxed experiment for platform teams to validate inference economics and reliability fast
- Low-risk demo: run against a narrow integration path (chat/QA, reranking, or embed lookup)
- Outputs we need: latency profile, cost delta, and fallback behavior report
Speaker note: Emphasize that outcome is evidence not a finished integration. Sellers should set expectation: quick learning not immediate launch.

Slide 3 - The 15/30/60 cadence (playflow)
- 15m: discovery + pick scenario (owner: seller)
  - Agree success metric (p95 latency target, unit cost threshold, quality check)
- 30m: smoke run + canary (owner: ops SE)
  - Deploy minimal route, run 50–200 requests, watch traces and KV cache hits
- 60m: synthesis + ask-for-next-step (owner: AM/SE)
  - Summarize results, propose dedicated pilot or rollback
Speaker note: Keep guardrails simple. Use pre-provisioned dev model variants to avoid long spinups.

Slide 4 - Quick checklist for seller handoff
- Confirm scenario and test data set (redacted)
- Routing policy to use (latency-first | cost-first)
- Target model variant and quantization profile
- Fallback policy: model variant + region failover
- Success threshold (p95 <= X ms, embed cosine >= 0.8)
Speaker note: Use this checklist as a one-pager to attach in calendar invite.

Slide 5 - Ops playbook (what SRE/ops watches)
- Live metrics: p50/p95/p99, throughput, error rate, token cost estimate
- Traces: correlate request id -> routing decision -> backend model instance
- Quick mitigations: drop batching size, switch to smaller variant, enable cache-only responses
- Escalation: if error rate > 3% for 5m -> pause traffic and notify SE + customer success
Speaker note: Include exact PromQL and trace links in final deck. This slide is a placeholder for instrumentation snippets.

Slide 6 - Seller script + objection snippets
- 30s opener: "We’ll run a short reliability test that shows expected latency and cost for your query type — it’s safe and reversible."
- Common objection: "What if it slows our app?" -> reply: "We run in a controlled dev route, plus fallbacks ensure live traffic is unaffected."
- Close ask: "Can we schedule a 45m micro-battle next week and invite ops?"
Speaker note: Keep language non-technical for execs, more explicit for platform engineers.

Slide 7 - Data capture template (for 60m synthesis)
- Rows to capture: scenario name, sample size, p50/p95/p99, avg token cost, model variant, cache hit %, notes on hallucination/errors
- Quick chart ideas: latency distribution + cost per 1k tokens; error waterfall by model variant
- Golden signal to flag: quality regression > 5% compared to baseline prompt set
Speaker note: Attach CSV template to calendar and request engineer to populate during run.

Slide 8 - Next steps & open questions
- Next steps: pilot proposal template, legal checklist for dataset sharing, reserved capacity ask flow
- Open questions: what minimal guardrail for regulated customers? who signs off on dedicated capacity for micro-pilot?
- Action owners: Maya (owner), Ethan (ops runbook), Sofia (seller scripts)
Speaker note: This sketch should become a reproducible repo with scripts and dashboards.

Appendix (rough notes / todo):
- Add example PromQL and Grafana panels for p95 and cost per token
- Create a short runbook to switch a route to fallback model variant automatically
- Draft calendar invite template with pre-populated test dataset instructions
- File examples of acceptable redacted sample data to attach for customers

Draft flags and open items (notes to self):
- Need legal signoff for temporary dataset ingestion for 3 customers (ask legal: Amelia Grant)
- Verify if default routing policy list includes 'cost-first' option in hosted API (engineering: @noah)
- Prototype script to run 200 synthetic queries against demo dataset (ops PR referenced)

References and links: GTM-3421 (pilot tracker), internal confluence draft, github PR for demo scripts.

End of deck sketch. This is intentionally light on polished visuals — focus on sequencing, ownership, and measurements.
